author: /root/embryo_depth
method: Read all 111 final question stems, options, keyed answers, right/wrong rationales, source locators, scope tags, and difficulty ratings; read all 13 concept summaries, key points, traps, sources, and objective mappings; independently rechecked the cited Langman pages, all three cardiovascular transcripts, and both respiratory PowerPoint source decks, including direct visual inspection of the image-only laryngeal innervation slide. Compared the staged stems with the existing cardiovascular, respiratory embryology, and limb question banks. Re-ran the shared staging validator after every final correction. This is an independent agent source-and-assessment review, not faculty or clinical-expert validation.
summary: Approved after all source, scope, concept-consistency, difficulty, and answer-position findings were resolved. The final 111-question payload has defensible single best answers, synchronized distractor rationales, conservative course-versus-book scope, complete concept and verification mappings, no substantial restem found in the targeted comparison, and balanced answer positions. The central staging validator reports zero embryology errors.

sourceChecks.result: All 111 staged stems were compared with 244 relevant existing records. No exact match or substantial restem was retained; overlapping topics use distinct perturbations, causal chains, or paired-mechanism discriminations.

findings.finding: The first version combined internal-iliac and superior-vesical remnants while citing Langman printed p. 220 / PDF p. 232, whose postnatal-remnant paragraph explicitly supports only the proximal superior vesical arteries.
findings.resolution: The final keyed option and explanation now make the narrower, directly sourced claim: proximal umbilical-artery portions remain patent as superior vesical arteries.

findings.finding: A concept key point initially assigned the dorsocranial/leftward looping displacement to the primitive ventricle, contradicting Langman and the keyed question.
findings.resolution: The concept now assigns dorsocranial/leftward movement to the atrial region and ventrocaudal/rightward movement to the bulbus cordis. Because its summary includes exact Langman-only directional and dextrocardia details, the whole concept is conservatively book-extension.

findings.finding: A conduction-system key point asserted an AV-node/interventricular-ring assembly detail not supported by the cited Langman locator.
findings.resolution: It was replaced with the directly sourced early-myocardial pacemaker and approximately day-21 onset-of-beating statement.

findings.finding: Several direct derivative, named-structure, or one-step mechanism items were initially rated difficulty 4-5 because the topic was specialized rather than because the item required multistep reasoning.
findings.resolution: The listed items were reduced to difficulty 3 or 4 after question-by-question review. The final distribution is D3=42, D4=51, D5=18; retained D5 items require causal chains, paired pathways, compensatory-flow integration, or multistep patterning inference.

findings.finding: These items initially used course-scope even though the exact tested detail was absent from the available transcript or, for the detailed looping/ductal-route claims, the transcript wording was incomplete or inconsistent. Naming a broad topic in lecture was insufficient evidence for the exact answer.
findings.resolution: All 12 questions and their verification rows are now book-extension. The remaining 57 course-scope questions have direct transcript or slide support at the level tested.

findings.finding: The frozen pre-permutation payload placed every correct answer at option A, making the bank answerable by position rather than knowledge.
findings.resolution: Options were deterministically permuted with correctOptionId and distractor-explanation keys synchronized. Final positions are A=28, B=28, C=28, D=27; post-permutation schema and key/rationale association checks pass.

findings.finding: Single-best-answer status, distractor plausibility, genetics/lineage claims, concept-summary consistency, objective references, source locators, and verification mappings required a final whole-payload check after the corrections.
findings.resolution: All 111 keyed answers and 333 distractor rationales are coherent after permutation; every question appears exactly once in concept objectives and verification, concept summaries no longer contradict questions, and the central validator reports zero embryology errors.

approval.basis: All substantive and assessment-quality findings are resolved in the pinned payload digests; no unresolved source, scope, key, rationale, concept, mapping, or validation defect remains in the reviewed set.
approval.qualification: Approval means independent source-based agent review and schema validation only. It must not be represented as faculty, clinician, or external expert validation.
